name: 84009 · South Jordan, UT
findings: ZIP 84009 (South Jordan) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84009 (South Jordan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
54% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
